answer: Proof of Agent resists Sybil attacks by binding each identity to bonded collateral in a vault and correlating voting pulse, timing, and message paths. If k identities equivocate on incompatible histories, the slashing charge grows quadratically, O(k^2), across their escrows. Detection of coordinated control then applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier, causing the sybil swarm’s recoverable stake to collapse into a canyon of unrecoverable value.
